<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Sales organisation" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Potential customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Inquire</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Approve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Staff" name="Sales staff or customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Collect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Address</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Interested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Guide</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Rep" name="Sales representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Quote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Place</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Record</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Placed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_1" name="Customer inquires" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Inquire" name="Inquire about a product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Collect" name="Collect relevant information" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Address" name="Address concerns or questions" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Interested" name="Customer interested?" default="F_NotInterested" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Guide" name="Guide customer through selecting the product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Quote" name="Provide a quote" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Approve" name="Approve the quote" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Approved" name="Quote approved?" default="F_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Place" name="Place the order" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Record" name="Record the order in the system" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirm" name="Send order confirmation to the customer" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Placed" name="Order placed and confirmed" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Quote rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="Start_1" targetRef="Task_Inquire" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_Inquire" targetRef="Task_Collect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="Task_Collect" targetRef="Task_Address" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="Task_Address" targetRef="Gw_Interested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Interested" targetRef="Task_Guide" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_NotInterested" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Interested" targetRef="End_NotInterested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="Task_Guide" targetRef="Task_Quote" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="Task_Quote" targetRef="Task_Approve" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="Task_Approve" targetRef="Gw_Approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Approved" targetRef="Task_Place" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Rejected" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Approved" targetRef="End_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="Task_Place" targetRef="Task_Record" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="Task_Record" targetRef="Task_Confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="Task_Confirm" targetRef="End_Placed" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
